instructions_for_agent: Execute sprints in order (sprint_number ascending). Do NOT start a sprint until all tasks in the previous sprint are marked done and acceptance_criteria are met. Within a sprint, tasks can be done in listed order. After finishing each sprint, run a quick smoke test of the affected pages before moving on.

sprints.title: Critical Security Lockdown
sprints.goal: Stop active data/payment exposure before touching anything else.

tasks.issue: Firestore allows unrestricted public read/write to all collections.
tasks.fix: Replace open rule with role-based rules: require request.auth != null and admin custom claim for admin collections; restrict public writes to booking creation only, validated by schema.

tasks.issue: Paymob API key, public key, secret key, and HMAC are hardcoded in client-side JS.
tasks.fix: Remove all hardcoded keys from the file. Rotate all 4 keys in the Paymob dashboard immediately. Move payment initiation and secret key usage to a backend (Cloud Function).

tasks.issue: Payment success is inferred from iframe/postMessage without HMAC signature verification.
tasks.fix: Add a server-side (Cloud Function) HMAC verification endpoint for Paymob callbacks. Only mark paymentStatus as paid after server verification. Make the transaction idempotent.

tasks.issue: Firebase Storage is never initialized outside mock mode; production upload calls crash.
tasks.fix: After firebase.initializeApp(), add: const storage = firebase.storage(); window.storage = storage;

tasks.issue: Committed log file exposes local file paths and a signed-in email address.
tasks.fix: Delete the file from the repo and git history. Add 'firebase-debug.log' and '*.log' to .gitignore.

tasks.issue: Firebase config hardcoded with no environment separation, compounding the open-rules risk.
tasks.fix: Move Firebase config values to an environment-specific config approach. Ensure Firestore/Storage rules are strict regardless of key exposure (Firebase keys are not secret by design, but rules must be).

acceptance_criteria: Firestore rules deny unauthenticated writes to sensitive collections
No Paymob secret/API/public keys or HMAC string appear anywhere in js/paymob.js
A Firestore write with an unverified payment cannot set paymentStatus to paid
Uploading a doctor photo or clinic logo works in production mode without console errors
firebase-debug.log no longer exists in the repo and is gitignored

sprints.title: Auth, Booking Integrity & Firestore Indexes
sprints.goal: Fix authentication trust issues and prevent double-booking / query failures.

tasks.issue: checkAuth() renders admin UI from a cached localStorage user before Firebase verifies it.
tasks.fix: Wait for onAuthStateChanged to resolve before rendering any protected admin content.

tasks.issue: Logout calls auth.signOut() directly without clearing the persisted auth cache.
tasks.fix: Route all logout actions through window.adminSignOut() so the cache is cleared consistently.

tasks.issue: No transaction guarding slot booking; two users can book the same slot at once.
tasks.fix: Wrap slot availability check + booking write in firebase.firestore().runTransaction().

tasks.issue: On-the-fly generated slots ('fly-' IDs) are never persisted to Firestore, so booking them fails in production.
tasks.fix: Persist generated slots to Firestore before booking, or create+book them atomically inside the same transaction.

tasks.issue: Every doctor edit regenerates slots without removing old unbooked ones, creating duplicates.
tasks.fix: Before generating new slots, delete/replace existing future unbooked slots for that doctor.

tasks.issue: Message and iframe load listeners are never removed; payment success can fire multiple times.
tasks.fix: Add listeners with { once: true }, guard with a paymentCompleted flag, and remove listeners after completion.

tasks.issue: Indexes array is empty; several compound queries will fail at runtime.
tasks.fix: Add composite indexes for: doctorId+appointmentDate (booking.js), isActive+displayOrder (portal.js), specialtyId+isActive (doctors-list.js), doctorId+isBooked (appointment-booking.js). Deploy indexes.

tasks.issue: Mock auth mode accepts any non-empty email/password as a valid admin session.
tasks.fix: Disable mock auth fallback in production; fail loudly with an error message if Firebase init fails instead of silently granting admin access.

acceptance_criteria: Refreshing an admin page while logged out never briefly shows admin data
Logging out from any admin page clears localStorage auth cache
Two rapid concurrent booking attempts on the same slot: only one succeeds
Booking a fly-generated slot succeeds and persists correctly in Firestore
Editing a doctor's schedule twice does not create duplicate slot documents
A completed Paymob payment cannot trigger onPaymentSuccess() twice
All compound queries listed in H10 return results without a Firestore index error
Wrong Firebase config no longer silently logs the user in as admin

sprints.title: XSS Hardening & Status Model Unification
sprints.goal: Close injection points and make appointment status consistent everywhere.

tasks.issue: patientName/doctorName injected into innerHTML unescaped.
tasks.fix: Use the shared escHtml() helper or textContent instead of innerHTML string interpolation.

tasks.issue: Image URLs from Firestore (photo, logo, icon) inserted into src without validation.
tasks.fix: Validate that URLs start with https: before rendering; reject javascript: or other schemes.

tasks.issue: Reception uses arrived/in_session/done while admin appointments expects confirmed/completed, causing mismatched stats and workflow.
tasks.fix: Define a single status enum (e.g. pending, confirmed, arrived, in_session, completed, cancelled) and use it consistently across all modules. Document the state machine in a comment in common.js.

acceptance_criteria: Injecting an HTML tag into a patient/doctor name field does not execute in the dashboard
An image URL starting with javascript: is not rendered as an src
Reception and admin appointments pages show matching status labels and matching stats for the same appointment

sprints.title: Mobile Responsiveness
sprints.goal: Make the entire site usable on phone screen sizes; currently not responsive.

tasks.issue: Site layout is fixed/desktop-only; breaks or overflows on mobile viewports.
tasks.fix: Audit every page (public booking flow + admin panel) at 360px, 390px, and 768px widths. Add responsive breakpoints using CSS media queries. Convert fixed-width containers to fluid/percentage or flex/grid layouts.

tasks.issue: Booking flow (doctor list, slot picker, confirmation) is not tested or usable on small screens.
tasks.fix: Make doctor cards stack vertically on mobile, ensure slot picker buttons are touch-sized (min 44x44px), and forms don't require horizontal scrolling.

tasks.issue: Admin tables and dashboards are desktop-only.
tasks.fix: Add a mobile-friendly table pattern (horizontal scroll container or card-based row layout) for appointments/patients/payments tables on small screens.

tasks.issue: Verify viewport meta tag is present and correct.
tasks.fix: Ensure every page has <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">.

acceptance_criteria: No horizontal scrolling on any public or admin page at 360px width
All buttons/links are comfortably tappable on a real phone
Booking flow can be completed start to finish on a mobile viewport
Admin tables are readable and usable on mobile without pinch-zoom

sprints.title: UI Polish
sprints.goal: Make the visual design feel more modern and less generic, without a redesign from scratch.

tasks.issue: Current UI feels plain/templated.
tasks.fix: Introduce a cohesive design pass: consistent spacing scale, refined color palette (keep brand colors but improve contrast/hierarchy), improved typography (weight/size hierarchy for headings vs body), subtle shadows and rounded corners on cards, smooth hover/focus transitions on buttons and inputs.

tasks.issue: Booking flow lacks visual polish and clear step progress.
tasks.fix: Add a simple step indicator (e.g. Doctor > Slot > Details > Payment > Confirmation) at the top of the booking flow. Improve empty/loading states with clean skeleton or spinner styling instead of blank screens.

tasks.issue: Admin dashboard is functional but visually flat.
tasks.fix: Improve dashboard stat cards with icons, subtle color-coded accents per metric, and better spacing/grid alignment.

acceptance_criteria: Visual review confirms consistent spacing/typography across pages
Booking flow shows clear progress to the user at each step
Buttons and inputs have visible hover/focus states
No functional behavior changed, only visual layer

sprints.title: Subtle 3D Element on User-Facing Pages
sprints.goal: Add one lightweight, tasteful 3D visual to public pages, not overdone.

tasks.issue: Public pages are flat/static with no visual interest.
tasks.fix: Add ONE small, simple 3D element (e.g. a lightweight rotating icon/shape like a medical cross, pill capsule, or heartbeat pulse using a minimal library such as Three.js or a CSS 3D transform) placed in the hero/header area only. Keep it small, slow-moving, and non-distracting — it should not block content, delay page load, or appear on every page.

tasks.issue: 3D element must not hurt performance or mobile experience.
tasks.fix: Lazy-load the 3D asset/script so it doesn't block initial render. Disable or simplify the 3D element on mobile/low-power devices if it causes jank (e.g. show a static version instead).

acceptance_criteria: Exactly one subtle 3D element exists, placed only on user-facing (public) pages, not admin pages
It does not overlap or block booking flow content or buttons
Page load time is not noticeably affected
On mobile, the element either performs smoothly or gracefully falls back to a static version

sprints.title: Code Deduplication & Maintainability
sprints.goal: Reduce repeated logic and improve long-term maintainability.

tasks.file: reception.js, appointments.js, doctors.js, notifications.js, payments.js, reports.js, specialties.js, portal.js, doctors-list.js
tasks.issue: escHtml/escapeHtml duplicated across 9 files.
tasks.fix: Export a single window.escHtml from common.js and remove the duplicates from all other files.

tasks.issue: Identical Firebase/localStorage data-loading boilerplate repeated across modules.
tasks.fix: Create a shared data service layer (e.g. data.js) with reusable load/query functions for doctors, patients, specialties, appointments.

tasks.issue: selectedGender captured in UI but never persisted.
tasks.fix: Either save gender to the patient/appointment record, or remove the UI field entirely.

tasks.issue: maxAppointmentsPerDay is stored but never enforced.
tasks.fix: Enforce the daily cap during slot generation and validate again in saveAppointment().

tasks.issue: A new patient document is created on every booking, even for repeat phone numbers.
tasks.fix: Query patients by phone number before creating a new one; reuse the existing patient ID if found.

acceptance_criteria: escHtml exists in exactly one place and all modules reference it
No duplicated data-loading logic remains across admin modules
Gender field is either saved correctly or removed
Booking beyond maxAppointmentsPerDay for a doctor is blocked
Booking with an existing phone number reuses the existing patient record

sprints.title: Remaining Medium/Low Fixes & Project Hygiene
sprints.goal: Clean up remaining correctness, timezone, validation, and documentation gaps.

tasks.issue: 'New patients this month' stat counts total patients instead of patients created this month.
tasks.fix: Filter patients by createdAt within the current calendar month.

tasks.issue: Marking any status as arrived/in_session/done auto-marks payment as paid, even for non-cash appointments.
tasks.fix: Only auto-mark paid when paymentMethod === 'cash'.

tasks.issue: Date handling uses toISOString() (UTC) instead of clinic local time, causing slot date shifts near midnight.
tasks.fix: Use local date formatting based on Africa/Cairo timezone instead of UTC conversion.

tasks.issue: Base64 logo images can be saved directly into a Firestore document, risking the 1 MiB document size limit.
tasks.fix: Always upload images to Firebase Storage and store only the resulting URL in Firestore.

tasks.issue: Missing session data still shows a fake success page with a fabricated reference number.
tasks.fix: Redirect to the booking start page or show an explicit 'no booking found' error state instead.

tasks.issue: Missing doctorId/slotId/slotDate URL params still allow form submission.
tasks.fix: Validate required params on page load and block submission if any are missing.

tasks.issue: No file size or MIME type validation on image uploads.
tasks.fix: Reject files over 2-5MB and validate file.type before upload.

tasks.issue: No README, .env.example, or .gitignore exists.
tasks.fix: Add a README with setup instructions, a .env.example for Firebase config, and a root .gitignore covering logs and env files.

tasks.issue: CDN scripts (Firebase, Font Awesome) loaded without Subresource Integrity.
tasks.fix: Add integrity and crossorigin attributes to CDN <script>/<link> tags, or self-host these assets.

tasks.issue: No Content-Security-Policy is set.
tasks.fix: Add a restrictive CSP meta tag allowing only trusted script/style sources.

tasks.issue: refreshTimer interval is never cleared on page unload.
tasks.fix: Add window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => clearInterval(refreshTimer)).

tasks.issue: Silent empty catch blocks swallow errors.
tasks.fix: Log the error at minimum; handle sign-out/auth failures explicitly with user feedback.

tasks.issue: Firebase project ID has a typo ('clinc-mangment-system').
tasks.fix: Rename if changing the project ID is feasible without breaking existing data; otherwise document it.

tasks.issue: Inline onclick handlers used throughout.
tasks.fix: Replace with addEventListener-based event delegation for better CSP compliance and maintainability.

tasks.issue: Path prefix logic relies on pathname.includes('/public/'), which breaks under different hosting paths.
tasks.fix: Make the base path configurable instead of hardcoded string matching.

acceptance_criteria: Dashboard 'new patients this month' reflects only current-month patients
Reception only auto-marks paid for cash payment method
Slot dates remain correct near midnight in Cairo time
No base64 image data is written directly to a Firestore document
Direct navigation to confirmation page without a valid booking shows an error, not fake success
Booking with missing URL params is blocked
Oversized or wrong-type file uploads are rejected with a clear message
README, .env.example, and .gitignore exist at project root
CDN script tags include integrity attributes
A CSP meta tag is present on all pages
No console errors related to uncleared timers after navigating away
All previously empty catch blocks now log or handle the error

sprints.title: Test Coverage
sprints.goal: Establish baseline automated testing for the highest-risk flows.

tasks.issue: Zero test coverage anywhere in the project.
tasks.fix: Set up a lightweight test framework (e.g. Vitest or Jest). Write tests for: booking flow (slot select -> pay -> confirm), Firestore security rules (using the Firebase emulator + rules-unit-testing), auth/session handling, slot generation (no duplicates, timezone correctness), status transitions between reception and admin, and XSS escaping helpers.

acceptance_criteria: A test suite runs via a single command (e.g. npm test)
Booking, security rules, and status-transition tests exist and pass
CI runs the test suite on every push (even a simple GitHub Actions workflow)
